major_cooldowns.name: Summon Darkglare
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it with Soul Shards banked and before you start chaining Unstable Affliction, so its 20% dot amp covers those casts for their whole duration.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 205180 is both the cast id (5/5 parses) and the self aura the logs carry for the pet window.

major_cooldowns.name: Dark Harvest
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Start the channel only while Agony and your other dots outlast it, and sync it to the Darkglare window so the shards it grants Soul Harvester feed Unstable Affliction.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base_cd_s is 60; the guide states Cull the Weak brings it to roughly 40s, so 40 is used here. Sibling id 1257065 shares the name and was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Malevolence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it every minute so every second cast lines back up with Summon Darkglare, adding 6 stacks to each active Wither.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Hellcaller capstone, castable per tooltip but not pressed in the sampled parses, which all look like Soul Harvester builds. Sibling id 446285 shares the name and was also unobserved.

major_cooldowns.name: Emberwing Heatwave
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire your on-use trinket inside the Darkglare or Malevolence window, or in the last 20 seconds of the fight.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket cast in 2 of 5 sampled parses; talent_gated is set so players without the trinket are not flagged for zero casts.

rule.description: Keep Agony ticking on your targets
rule.action: Refresh Agony before it expires on every target you are damaging, moving or not.

rule.description: Keep Haunt up on your priority target
rule.action: Recast Haunt the moment it drops off your priority target to hold the 16% damage taken buff.

rule.description: Malefic Grasp is your filler inside Darkglare
rule.action: Channel Malefic Grasp for your filler casts while Darkglare is out, and keep Shadow Bolt or Drain Soul for outside it.

rule.description: Spend Shard Instability on Unstable Affliction
rule.action: Fire the free instant Unstable Affliction, or Seed of Corruption in AoE, as soon as the proc lands.
Re-cast Unstable Affliction on a target that already has it before the haste buff runs out.

rule.description: Open Haunt, Agony, Darkglare, Unstable Affliction
rule.action: Precast Haunt, apply Agony and your dot on pull, then send Darkglare before you chain Unstable Affliction.

rule.description: Pair Dark Harvest with every Summon Darkglare
rule.action: Line Dark Harvest up with the Darkglare window so its shards refill you once your pooled ones are spent.

rule.description: Bank Soul Shards before Summon Darkglare
rule.action: Pool shards into Darkglare so you can chain Unstable Affliction the moment it lands.
